_about: SWITCH2D per-family art overrides for the flat resource cards (scripts/world/card_prop.gd visual_for()). A family row wins over the family's own painted art; "role_fallback" is used when a family's art has not been cut yet, so no resource is ever drawn as a 3D model under resource_render "card". Keys are nature family ids from game/data/nature_manifest.json; sprite ids are ids from game/data/world/sprites2d.json (read at runtime, never hard-coded in code).
